note.question: How should auction be designed for wi-fi procurement?
note.overview: The unprecedented growth of cellular traffic driven by the use of smartphones for web surfing, video streaming, and cloud-based services poses bandwidth challenges for cellular service providers. To manage the increasing data traffic, cellular service providers are experimenting with the use of third-party Wi-Fi hot spots to augment their cellular capacity. The paper develops an analytical framework to study the optimal procurement auction for Wi-Fi capacity.
